summary: backup-server's POST /upload takes an optional valid_for (positive Go duration, e.g. 52h). Once the backup lands it writes <object>.metadata.json holding {"valid_for":"52h"} as plain JSON. Invalid values are refused with 400 before anything is stored, and a failed metadata write cleans up and returns 500. Prune counts backups only and clears the metadata of pruned or missing backups. DockerImages 8ea9e12 on phase/023-P1: go vet and gofmt clean, go test ./... green. The done-record is appended, and P2/P4/P6 now name the parameter and the metadata seams.
